name: Bahadir Kimya Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
summary: Bahadir Kimya Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. manufactures and sells chemical products in Turkey and internationally. It offers engine, industrial, gear, and transmission oils; radiator antifreeze; brake pad cleaning spray; spray paint; rust remover spray; mold release agent; gas welding spray; silicone; polyurethane foam; sealant; and gas canisters. The company was founded in 1974 and is based in Kirikkale, Turkey.
